host_scope.transport: direct wired or USB-bus UHID; no wireless testing

sanitization: All clocks relative to each session origin. No raw logs, capture bytes, serial strings, device addresses, node paths, accounts or populated named records published. Source paths in named read requests are protocol constants, not host filesystem paths.
measurement_limits: Owner intent/report markers include switching and typing delays.
Raw descriptor observations sampled every 50 ms; udev node inventory every 10 ms. FD gone/seen times are sampled bounds, not exact close syscall timestamps.
Parent UHID lifecycle events do not directly report closing the layered Steam raw descriptor.
Latency measures provider event dequeue to reply submission; prior queue residence and Steam scheduling were not measured.
Both baseline discovery entries referred to the same layered hidraw; a reappearing evdev node was not proven to be the UI entry.
First candidate had a long idle interval before UI; fresh second candidate reproduced the stable result.
Physical A1 excluded from clean pair: initial UI attempt preceded attachment and System Settings retained a raw handle after Steam exited.

ui_parity.grip_touch: Left then right grab/release changed matching fan and reverse-side line activity in virtual UI, consistent with owner physical observations. Physical left timing qualified by owner switching reverse view using L4; not an independent analog-axis calibration.

Additional grab-phase pulses observed. This is reverse-output evidence, not a physical felt-click observation.
